summary: The governments of the UK, Ireland, Canada, France, Germany and Poland tell their own citizens that they need a visa for Guinea-Bissau; Singapore's says Singaporeans may stay up to 90 days with a visa issued on arrival. Germany's foreign ministry says a visa can be obtained on arrival at the airport, but not at a land border. ECOWAS says citizens of Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger continue to enjoy, until further notice, the right of movement, residence and establishment without visas under its protocols.

tips.text: Germany's foreign ministry says no visa is available at Guinea-Bissau's land borders. The UK government says Guinea-Bissau has embassies in neighbouring countries, including Senegal, where you may be able to get a visa, and Poland's says tourists travelling through Senegal can apply at the embassy in Dakar or the consulate in Ziguinchor.

Canada's travel advice says that to reach the Bijagós Islands from the mainland you must use chartered air services or travel by boat, that tour operators organise boat trips to the islands, and to avoid pirogues, as they are unsafe.

The UK government says credit cards are rarely used and there are not many ATMs, and Canada says there are none. Canada also says import and export of local currency is prohibited, while foreign currency may be imported without limit provided it is declared on arrival.

Canada's travel advice says that on 26 November 2025, following the presidential election, the army seized power and formed a transitional government. The UK government advises avoiding sensitive areas like military installations and government buildings and following the advice of local authorities in the event of any political unrest.

faq.question: Do I need a visa for Guinea-Bissau?
faq.answer: It depends on your passport, and for most passports no official source we could read states the rule. The governments of the UK, Ireland, Canada, France, Germany and Poland tell their own citizens that they need a visa; Ireland's foreign ministry says Irish citizens can apply in person at diplomatic missions of Guinea-Bissau, such as the embassies in Paris or Lisbon, and that the cost depends on the length of stay: 45 days (EUR 70), 90 days (EUR 110) or 180 days (EUR 200). Singapore's foreign ministry says Singaporeans may stay up to 90 days with a visa issued on arrival. ECOWAS says citizens of Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger continue to enjoy, until further notice, the right of movement, residence and establishment without visas under its protocols.

faq.question: How does the visa on arrival in Guinea-Bissau work?
faq.answer: No official source we could read describes a visa on arrival open to every passport. Germany's foreign ministry says German citizens need a visa applied for before entry at Guinea-Bissau's embassy in Brussels, that a visa can be obtained on arrival at the airport (EUR 80 for 30 days), and that none is available at a land border. France's says a visa can be obtained at Bissau airport when your contact has told the immigration department in advance, in an emergency, or when your country of departure has no Guinea-Bissau embassy or consulate, and that payment must be made in cash. Singapore's says Singaporeans may stay up to 90 days with a visa issued on arrival.

faq.question: Do I need a yellow fever vaccination for Guinea-Bissau?
faq.answer: Yes, according to the UK Foreign Office: you must have a certificate proving yellow fever vaccination to enter Guinea-Bissau.

faq.question: Is Guinea-Bissau safe to visit?
faq.answer: Canada's travel advice says to exercise a high degree of caution because of high crime rates and weak state infrastructure, that on 26 November 2025, following the presidential election, the army seized power, that petty crime, including pickpocketing, is common at the airport, in markets and at public gatherings, and that even peaceful demonstrations can turn violent at any time.

faq.question: Can I pay by card in Guinea-Bissau?
faq.answer: The UK government says Guinea-Bissau is a cash-based economy where credit cards are rarely used and there are not many ATMs, and Canada says there are no ATMs. Canada also says foreign currency may be imported without limit provided it is declared on arrival.
